name: Silicon

lattice.source: CODATA-recommended silicon lattice parameter a(Si, 295.7 K) = 5.431020511(89) A

terminations.description: Ideal bulk truncation, one dangling bond per surface atom.
Ideal bulk truncation, two dangling bonds per surface atom.
Monohydride Si(111):H-1x1, the wet-chemically prepared ideally flat surface.

reconstructions.description: Takayanagi dimer-adatom-stacking-fault reconstruction of clean Si(111).
reconstructions.reference: K. Takayanagi et al., Surf. Sci. 164 (1985) 367
reconstructions.note: Not implemented. Requesting it returns an explicit unsupported record rather than an approximate structure; the surface is built as the unreconstructed (111) truncation and labelled as such.

reconstructions.description: Rows of surface dimers on Si(100): neighbouring surface atoms pair along their dangling-bond direction, halving the periodicity in that direction.
reconstructions.reference: R. E. Schlier and H. E. Farnsworth, J. Chem. Phys. 30 (1959) 917
reconstructions.note: The relaxed geometry is whatever the recommended classical potential predicts. Stillinger-Weber has no mechanism for the charge transfer that buckles the real dimer, so it returns a symmetric dimer: the buckling and the low-temperature c(4x2) and p(2x2) orderings are not reproduced and are reported as unsupported by this tier.
reconstructions.method: Generator establishes the dimer pairing from the slab's own back-bond geometry and then relaxes with the material's recommended interatomic model. No bond length is prescribed.

bond_length_A.method: LEED structure analysis, clean Si(001)-(2x1), room temperature
bond_length_A.source: H. Over, J. Wasserfall, W. Ranke, C. Ambiatello, R. Sawitzki, D. Wolf and W. Moritz, Phys. Rev. B 55 (1997) 4731

buckling_A.method: LEED structure analysis, vertical separation of the up and down dimer atom
buckling_A.source: H. Over, J. Wasserfall, W. Ranke, C. Ambiatello, R. Sawitzki, D. Wolf and W. Moritz, Phys. Rev. B 55 (1997) 4731
buckling_A.note: Zero by construction in any model without dimer charge transfer.

tilt_deg.method: LEED structure analysis, dimer tilt out of the surface plane
tilt_deg.source: H. Over, J. Wasserfall, W. Ranke, C. Ambiatello, R. Sawitzki, D. Wolf and W. Moritz, Phys. Rev. B 55 (1997) 4731

band_gap.source: S. M. Sze, Physics of Semiconductor Devices, 3rd ed.

band_gap_type.source: classification following the band-gap reference cited for this material

thermal_expansion.source: Y. Okada and Y. Tokumaru, J. Appl. Phys. 56 (1984) 314

bulk_modulus.source: derived from the lattice parameters in this file

cohesive_energy.source: C. Kittel, Introduction to Solid State Physics, 8th ed.
